muthuishere-hand-drawn-diagrams-root.description: Create hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams, flows, explainers, wireframes, and page mockups. Default to monochrome sketch output; allow restrained color only for page mockups when the user explicitly wants webpage-like fidelity. Use when the user asks for a diagram, flowchart, wireframe, sketch, visual explanation, mind map, architecture overview, or any Excalidraw-based drawing.
